brief: Duplicate of the gilroy-roofing build (owl template) for Smile Lawn Care & Landscapers, Wilkes-Barre PA. Operator-supplied palette, logo, 7 services and 18 service areas.

client_funnel.note: MLA-built GoHighLevel funnel, homepage only — every inner path (services, areas, our-work, pricing, contact, legal) 404s. This is also the website on the client's Google Business Profile.

client_own_domain.note: DEAD — no A record, no MX. The funnel's nav links all point here, so none of them resolve. All page copy beyond the home page had to be written fresh.

directories.note: Yelp / Yahoo Local / EZlocal used only for the street address. None published review text.

business.name: Smile Lawn Care
business.tagline_source: Their own funnel H1: 'EXPERT LAWN CARE & LANDSCAPING'
business.years_note: NOT PUBLISHED anywhere verifiable. Earliest Google review is 2024-04-20 and the logo asset was uploaded to the GHL CDN in March 2024. No 'since 20XX' claim appears anywhere on the site — deliberately.

derived.note: accent_ink/accent_edge derived because #79a832 fails contrast as a text colour on white (2.81:1) and on the yellow (1.86:1).

logo.note: Original PNG pulled from the filesafe CDN (896x808 RGBA, transparent). The f_webp CDN variant transcodes to WebP despite the .png path.

service_areas_note: All Pennsylvania. 17 in Luzerne County; Moosic is Lackawanna County. Hudson and Hilldale are villages within Plains Township, not boroughs.
